## KAI Inventory

::: {.content-card}
### Dr. Kirton Adaptive-Innovative Assessment

The assessment site identifies your KAI inventory results as a total score of 84 with these sub-scores:

- Idea Generation - Sufficiency of Originality (SO): 40
- Methodology - Efficiency (E): 8

::: {.content-card}
### Myers-Briggs Type Indicator

The assessment resulted in both ENTJ and ESTJ.

ENTJ: effective organizers of people and long-range planners. Strategic, logical, efficient, outgoing, ambitious, independent.

ESTJ: like to run the show and get things done in an orderly fashion. Efficient, outgoing, analytical, systematic, dependable, realistic.
